{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scythe Weapon''' was an exotic and powerful weapon mounted on the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]''.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> The ''Vagabond'' had six individual Scythe Weapons which fired from different points on the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] hull. When the individual beams converged, the resulting interaction was capable of destroying anything at the target location.<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
